key_impacts: Estimated 70,000 excess deaths in western Europe during the summer
Sustained record high temperatures led to markedly higher death rates, especially among the elderly
evidence_snippets: The hot summer of 2003 in Europe produced sustained record high temperatures
It has been estimated that 70,000 more deaths occurred in western Europe during that extreme summer than expected
